description: SEARCH-page PLA SKUs responded/served for search queries on a marketplace over a period: for each search keyword, serving cache_type (relevancy algorithm), SKU id and product attributes (product name, brand, e_product_type category), with impressions, valid clicks and spend. Spend comes from the bid on valid clicks (response-to-clicks mapping), not from impressions. Used to investigate keyword-to-SKU irrelevancy. FILTER ON KEYWORD: this report reads the full response mapping, so an unscoped fetch scans the whole period for every keyword and will not return. KAM does not enforce externalRequiredFilters, so the caller must apply it. Optionally also filter by internal_campaign_id, brand, category or product_name.

keyword.description: The normalised search query the shopper typed (lower-cased, stripped of bracket/quote/comma chars).

cache_type.description: The OnlineSales relevancy algorithm / cache that served this SKU for the keyword (e.g. exact, broad, auto match).

sku_id.description: Identifier of the SKU that was responded/served for the search query.

product_name.description: Product name of the served SKU (from the marketplace product-dimensions table).

category.description: Product category (e_product_type) of the served SKU.

internal_campaign_id.description: Internal campaign id of the campaign that served the SKU. NOTE: this is the internal id, not the marketing campaign id shown in the UI - the two are not 1:1 (3.3% of internal ids map to several marketing ids), so they cannot be translated here. Optional per-call filter.

impressions.description: Impressions served for the keyword x cache_type x SKU.

clicks.description: Valid clicks on the SKU for this keyword.

spend.description: Spend in marketplace currency, from bid on valid clicks.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(impr.search_query, '["],')) AS search_query, impr.cache_type, impr.sku_id, impr.campaign_id, mpd.e_name, mpd.e_brand, mpd.e_product_type, COUNTIF(impr.unique_impressions > 0) AS impressions FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_response_to_impressions_mapping` AS impr JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS mc ON mc.client_id = impr.marketplace_client_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.oltp_merchandise_product_dimensions___SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__` AS mpd ON mpd.sku_id = impr.sku_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND mc.client_id = '__SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__' AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(impr.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND impr.page_type = 'SEARCH' AND impr.impressions_timestamp_utc >= DATETIME_SUB(DATETIME '__START_DATE_1__', INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND impr.impressions_timestamp_utc < DATETIME_ADD(DATETIME '__END_DATE_1__', INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7) AS impr LEFT JOIN (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(impr.search_query, '["],')) AS search_query, impr.cache_type, impr.sku_id, impr.campaign_id, COUNTIF(impr.is_valid_click) AS clicks, SUM(CASE WHEN impr.is_valid_click THEN COALESCE(impr.bid, 0) * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END) AS spend FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_response_to_clicks_mapping` AS impr JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS mc ON mc.client_id = impr.marketplace_client_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.oltp_merchandise_product_dimensions___SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__` AS mpd ON mpd.sku_id = impr.sku_id LEFT JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND mc.client_id = '__SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__' AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(impr.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND impr.page_type = 'SEARCH' AND impr.click_timestamp_utc >= DATETIME_SUB(DATETIME '__START_DATE_1__', INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND impr.click_timestamp_utc < DATETIME_ADD(DATETIME '__END_DATE_1__', INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) AS clk USING (search_query, cache_type, sku_id, campaign_id) JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.oltp_merchandise_product_dimensions___SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__` AS mpd ON mpd.sku_id = impr.sku_id WHERE TRUE AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
